harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-22, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#654; borg-reborn-rs #931-#934). Six arms on one build, classes-18, 18
starts per arm (108 cells), 100,000 turns, evidence retained; every switch is shipped 0, so ctl is track-p's play. Gate: no config_error;
one binary; each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls and wall timeouts apart;
identical plays per arm (osc may move many games: it first fires at turn 33,295 in the named case). Report per arm and class: deaths and
causes, CL and depth, paired rescued and newly killed against ctl; per game the counts of each switch's note ("(#931)", "(#932)", "(#933)",
"(#934)"); for osc and poison the deaths within 20 thinks after a "No retreat" note. The seed 829474344 is a classes-1800 start. If capacity
is short: ctl, osc, kill, all first. Small + medium (and classes-1800-big-rangers) only on the owner's go. Directional (RULES 14).
